data.description: Poor Customer Experience with Lulu and Georgia
data.content:
I recently purchased the Kapala Nesting Coffee Table and was very disappointed when it arrived. The silver and white hardware underneath the marble top is fully visible at eye level, especially when sitting on a couch nearby. This makes the piece look unfinished and quite cheap for a marble coffee table that costs nearly $2,000.

This detail is not accurately depicted on the website. The product images do not show how large and visible the screws are around the outside of the table, which was very surprising once the item was delivered.

When I contacted customer service to initiate a return, I was told I would be responsible for a 10% restocking fee and would not be reimbursed for shipping, because the screws are considered part of the hardware. Given that the product photos do not clearly show this design element, this felt extremely unreasonable.

I have spent over $15,000 with this company over time and have unfortunately continued to experience disappointing customer service. It’s frustrating to feel like loyal customers are not valued, especially when raising legitimate concerns about product representation.

This experience has definitely made me rethink placing future orders with them.
